messages:
maya: Quick async check — for the Calypso11B onboarding I want to lock down the metrics contract (latency/cost/quality) and ownership before we open the catalog entry. Who's taking runtime SLAs vs curation/quality?
ben: I can own runtime SLA + routing fallbacks. Will set default latency SLO and error budget for Dedicated vs Hosted.
olga: I’ll take curation/quality (prompt evals, perf profile). also handling license ok/no-ok flags with legal.
ravi: tagging infra-bot to confirm canary capacity and autoscaler rules for the model. @infra-bot plan? :robot_face:
infra-bot: deploy-check: canary pool available in us-west2, estimated baseline QPS 120, GPU quanta reserved 2x for first week. See /deploy log: https://deploys/redwood/3332
jess: small ask: can we also add a per-model cost_estimate field in the catalog UI? Product wants a quick number for sales.
maya: yes — cost_estimate should come from Optimize recommendations. @ben can you ensure runtime emits token_cost metric?
ben: will add token_cost and per-request tokens in telemetry. also emit quantized_variant label when available.
olga: for quality metrics I propose: exact_match on our 200 prompt suite, avg_perplexity, and hallucination_rate (manual triage tag).
maya: draft metrics contract (small example) — pls review:
```json
{ "model": "calypso-11b", "metrics": { "p50_latency_ms": 120, "p95_latency_ms": 420, "token_cost_usd": 0.00007, "exact_match_pct": 92.3, "hallucination_rate_pct": 1.7 }, "owners": { "runtime": "ben", "curation": "olga", "infra": "ravi" } }
```
sam: looks good, but note licensing: legal flagged model with a CC-BY-NC portion — olga, do we need a restricted tag in the catalog?
olga: yes — adding "restricted_use": "no-commercial" field and a short note. will coordinate with legal for wording.
maya: timeline: want catalog listing + canary traffic by next Tue EOD. Owners confirm blockers?
ben: need a small runtime config change (max_batch=8) and an API-breaking telemetry key push — ETA Mon morning.
ravi: infra capacity OK but need a quota increase request for burst on Wed (I'll file now).
jess: product will need the cost_estimate UI by Tue AM — raising a quick PR for the front-end.
olga: I'm still waiting on legal confirmation for the license note — pinged them 2h ago. if no reply by EOD Monday, we mark as "requires-review" in catalog.
maya: action items: 1) ben -> add token_cost + quantized_variant labels (due Mon) 2) olga -> legal copy + restricted_use flag (due Mon EOD) 3) ravi -> quota increase ticket (filed) 4) jess -> cost_estimate UI PR (Due Tue AM) 5) maya -> final catalog entry + canary plan (Due Tue EOD).
ben: ack :thumbsup:
olga: ack, will update thread when legal responds.
ravi: quota ticket #INC-789 filed. linking it here: https://infra/tickets/INC-789
infra-bot: rollout-schedule: canary start Tue 09:00 UTC, ramp to 5% over 4h, observability hooks enabled.
maya: perfect — if no objections I’ll schedule the catalog publish and start the canary on Tue 09:00 UTC.
sam: no objections from sales side. please include cost_estimate in the publish payload.
maya: thanks everyone. I’ll do a final ping Monday morning with a preflight checklist. :pray:
